item.title: PennDOT Reduces Speed Limit on Interstate 81 in Schuylkill County Due to Weather
item.description: The Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT) has temporarily reduced the speed limit on a stretch of Interstate 81 in Schuylkill County due to hazardous weather conditions. According to PennDOT, the speed limit has been lowered to 55 miles per hour on Interstate 81 between Exit 138 (PA 309 – McAdoo/Tamaqua) and Exit 100 (PA 443 – Pine Grove). item.title: Pajamas or Camo? Police Looking to Identify Schuylkill County CVS Retail Theft Suspects
item.description: Pennsylvania State Police are seeking the public’s help in identifying two women accused of stealing merchandise from a CVS store in Schuylkill Haven.According to Pennsylvania State Police at Schuylkill Haven, troopers were dispatched to CVS Store, located at 212 Pottsville Street in North Manheim Township, Schuylkill County, on December 17, 2025, at approximately 11:41 a.m.Police say the two female suspects entered the store, concealed numerous items in their pockets, and exited without paying.

item.title: Pine Grove Borough Water Customers May Experience Low Water Pressure During Leak Repair
item.description: The Pine Grove Borough Water Department is currently working to repair a water leak along American Legion Boulevard. As crews address the issue, water customers living on East Pottsville Street, Pine Crest Village, and in Legion Acres may experience low water pressure or a temporary loss of water service. Borough officials say the work is necessary to correct the leak and restore normal service as quickly as possible. No estimated time for completion was immediately provided.

item.title: Frackville Woman Charged After Furniture Illegally Dumped in West Mahanoy Township
item.description: A Frackville woman is facing charges for illegal dumping in West Mahanoy Township.According to Township Police, on Friday, December 26, 2025, police were notified of an incident involving the illegal dumping of three pieces of furniture in the Altamont section of the township. item.title: Shenandoah Teen Reported Missing
item.description: The Shenandoah Police Department is looking for a teen that has been reported missing.According to police, Jeremiah James Morales, 15, has been missing since December 10th, 2025. Morales is reported to have contacts in Shenandoah, Pottsville, Hazleton, and Philadelphia. He is reported to be a student at the River Rock Academy in Cressona.Anyone with information his whereabouts is asked to contact the Shenandoah Police by calling (570) 462--1991.
